_what_this_is: The maintainer decision permitting ONE Phase-C1 Attempt-2 paid session. It is an INPUT to scripts/autoinit/issue_c1_authorization.py, which derives every identity — session commit, harness digest, isolation plan hash, science plan, execution preregistration, battery, teacher, scoring contract, seeds and ceiling — from the committed objects and REFUSES if this document asserts any of them. It is a NEW artifact: logs/autoinit_c1_grant.json authorized one issuance and one launch attempt, both of which were consumed by Attempt 1, and it cannot be reused.
granted_by: maintainer, Attempt-2 final grant review: GO. Attempt 1 remains classified as an infrastructure abort with no scientific C1 measurement; the transport failure is closed by the ninth pre-provider gate.
granted_for: Phase C1 fixed-path ATTENTION isolation — Attempt 2
covers: exactly one Attempt-2 C1 launch under the unchanged frozen protocol; 2 arms x 3 fresh seeds = 6 recovery probes, one confirmation evaluation per probe only after all six trainings complete, followed by the frozen paired decision.
cap_note: The project cumulative cap remains $283.7600 and is NOT raised. Worst case after one complete Attempt 2: $277.6961 spent, $6.0639 reserve.

attempt_1.scientific_stages_executed: none — no teacher fetch, no replay, no training, no evaluation, no decision

transport_gap_closed_by: bundle_staged_gate, the ninth pre-provider gate: the canonical bundle name is derived from the session commit, and the gate performs a read-only round-trip of the actual relay object — download, sha256 against the staged bundle, git bundle verify, clone, checkout the session commit, and require the authorization bytes and recomputed harness digest inside that checkout to be the authorized ones.

failure_semantics.replay_mismatch: stop before recovery; preserve the replay evidence; a real replay finding, but NOT ATTENTION behavioural evidence
failure_semantics.generation_admission_failure: C1_INCOMPLETE; preserve raw generations and the admission record; do not score that probe; evaluate no later probe; run no decision
failure_semantics.stage_i_precondition: six complete admitted and scored probe results

after_termination: verify authoritative provider termination via GraphQL. No C2 regardless of the C1 verdict. No third attempt without a new maintainer/scientific review.
